text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Netanyahu revives unity government talk.
-- Foreign Minister Levy: EU presses Palestinian President Arafat Arafat on terror.
-- Islamic Waqf breaks into Greek Patriarchate, claims rooms.
-- Netanyahu weighs unity government on basis of agreed "final status" red lines.
-- Wave of Hamas activist arrests expected after breaking of Sourif cell.
-- Jerusalem churches: Waqf annexed territory and built on it illegally next to Church of the Holy Sepulchre.
-- Netanyahu weighs Levy-Arafat meeting in Malta.
-- Bank of Israel Governor Frenkel to demand small budget cut; Finance Minister Meridor against cut in light of slowdown.
-- Palestinian Justice Minister: Five Jewish Zionists manage U.S. policy.
-- Debate in Labour; Concern in Likud; Tension in coalition.
-- Terrorist in Sourif cell had been arrested by police and released.
